title: Boolean tape configuration constructor
statement: Given a finite Boolean input string $z$, an optional machine state $q$, an input-head position $p$ among the $|z|+2$ positions, two tape contents $v_t,m_t:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\	ext{Bool})$, a work-tape head position $j\in\mathbb{Z}$, and a finite Boolean output string, this construction forms a configuration of a two-work-tape Turing machine with input $z$, state $q$, input-head position $p$, both work-tape head positions equal to $j$, and the given output. The work-tape contents are obtained from $v_t$ and $m_t$ by the construction used to combine them into the two tapes.
hypotheses_covered: tape contents vt and mt from integers to optional Booleans
integer head position j shared by both work tapes
caveat: The supplied statement refers to an auxiliary construction for combining the two tape contents, but its definition is not included, so their exact assignment to the two tapes cannot be specified.
